a02.query: How did ReLU affect training speed relative to saturating neurons in the DCNN paper?
a02.rewritten_query: ReLU rectified linear unit training speed saturating neurons DCNN paper
a02.hypothetical_document: The paper compares ReLU units to saturating neurons with respect to optimization efficiency. It reports that ReLU facilitated faster training than saturating activation functions, attributing this speed advantage to the absence of saturation effects during gradient-based learning.
